scope: External SoccerNet GSR human-ball annotations only; no possession labels, challenge video, or public-window selection.
training_overlap: Checkpoint metadata reports COCO training; clip-level overlap is not proven absent. SoccerNet-specific checkpoint is explicitly excluded because its training overlap is unresolved.

detector_selection_on_development.decision: Use generic YOLO26l at confidence 0.03 for externally scored anchored recovery; direct highest-confidence fusion is unsafe.

anchored_recovery_policy.inference_anchors: external human annotated balls only at the two unmasked endpoints; no human ball inside the gap
anchored_recovery_policy.ground_mapping: external human annotated player feet, never the ball reference
anchored_recovery_policy.scoring: unambiguous human annotated ball position within 1.5 m of projected ground path

long_gap_250_frame_post_validation_diagn.interpretation: Only the first and last 25 frames have detections; the 200-frame center remains missing. Do not interpret edge gains as full-gap reconstruction.

challenge_shaped_gap_followup.source: Input-only post-repair missing-ball gap p50 269 frames and p90 approximately 938 frames at 25 fps; not challenge possession truth.

269_frame_external_ball_reference.interpretation: Improvement is 10/1906 and 33/1751 additional correct positions, concentrated in 25-frame edge windows. No possession labels are available.

938_frame_structural_test.reason: Available GSR clips contain only 750 frames. A data-free regression test confirms at most 50 edge observations and an untouched 888-frame center.
938_frame_structural_test.challenge_input_only: 28 homography-qualified raw-ball endpoints belong to gaps at least 938 frames; 22/28 had a generic detector candidate within 40 pixels of projected tracking, which is not an accuracy label.

noisy_anchor_post_validation_stress.method: Each human endpoint is displaced by exactly 0.5, 1 or 2 m. Four deterministic, paired 90-degree rotations per clip use independent left/right directions. These are hypothetical perturbations, not measured challenge tracking errors.
noisy_anchor_post_validation_stress.interpretation: At 2 m the development accepted-position precision is 84.69%, and the previously inspected validation correct-position count no longer beats highest-confidence selection (1645 versus 1648 over paired trials). This is a hypothetical sensitivity limit, not a measured challenge condition or standalone release gate. Preserve it without quietly relaxing its numbers.

release_gate_policy: Use challenge-input-only gap, endpoint continuity and homography statistics to define external tests. Retain the original 2 m stress as a labeled sensitivity diagnostic rather than a presumed typical-error must-pass. Do not promote solely on input consistency or annotated ball localization: require non-regressed external possession guards, including tagged-path transfer, and a reproducible candidate. Do not tune against public challenge possession truth or inspect challenge output against video.

tracking_only_challenge_edge_dropout.source: Existing working config versus itself on provided raw tracking and tags; no possession truth, video review, or tuning.
tracking_only_challenge_edge_dropout.perturbation: Hide five or 25 observed frames immediately outside same-half 269/938+ frame raw-ball gaps at homography-qualified endpoints. These widths supplement, rather than replace, the unchanged periodic-mask policy.
tracking_only_challenge_edge_dropout.interpretation: The current tracking-only decoder is more sensitive to removing observations at real long-gap edges than the existing periodic 10/25-frame tests reveal. Differences from its own clean output are not errors against ground truth and cannot select a better model.

challenge_input_only_edge_path_activatio.selection: Four evenly spaced long raw-ball gaps per half and duration band (269-937 or 938+ frames), using only two observed tracking anchors and homography quality; no decoded possession or manually inspected video frames.
challenge_input_only_edge_path_activatio.interpretation: The frozen policy activates across both halves, including long gaps, but selects just 356/20,245 missing frames in the sampled runs. Every scanned edge frame has at least one candidate; this is detector coverage, not verified ball identity. No input-only activation result can prove a possession-spell improvement.

decision: Keep opt-in diagnostic, do not change the selected submission. Challenge-shaped 269-frame external tests improve ball localization only near endpoints. Unlabeled/absent ball frames cannot establish false-positive rates; noisy real-world tracking anchors, different camera geometry, tagged-path possession guards and private challenge spell-F1 remain unverified.
